question: What will be the area of a plot of quadrilateral shape, one of whose diagonals is 20 m and lengths of the perpendiculars from the opposite vertices on it are 12 m and 18 m, respectively?
solution:
**Given:** 

A quadrilateral plot one diagonal = 20 m 

lengths of the perpendiculars from the opposite vertices on it are 12 m and 18 m

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34aec8f7b7e89f4e45d6cd2425fde6d47ab14f51c06b28599db6e4d6ad97b920.png] 

The diagonal AC divides the quadrilateral into two triangles.

The triangles are Delta ABC and Delta ADC.

Let the perpendiculars dropped be M and N respectively.

⇒ BM = 18 m and DN = 12 m

Now, area of Delta ABC = (1/2) × 20×18 = 180m²

Similarly, area of Delta ADC = (1/2) × 20 × 12= 120m²

∴ Total area of a quadrilateral = Area(Delta АВС + Delta ​ADC) = 180 + 120 = 300 m²

Correct Answer: 4) 300 m²
